card.name: The word environmental before a noun
card.fires_on: The adjective "environmental" right after a modifier such as high, negative, potential or different, before a noun like temperature, impacts or conditions. It also fires weakly on similar adjectives such as "organizational" and "epidemiological".

modes.label: Environmental as adjective
modes.description: "environmental" modifies a following noun like impact, temperature, effects, allergens or conditions.
